description: Evidence for the verdict's C-compiler stance (defk-dtw.11): build a small app using defk kernels with mix release inside a stock Debian-based Elixir image (e.g. hexpm/elixir on debian, plus build-essential), run a kernel from the release, and record the Dockerfile, the packages that had to be added, and image/build-time cost in the verdict's Runtime contract or Limitations evidence.
